card.name: Verb after a brand drug name
card.fires_on: The word 'is' or 'are' right after an uppercase brand drug name that starts a sentence in dosing sections. Also fires on a few words like 'low', 'reduced' or 'co' in food or combination-drug lists.

modes.label: Be-verb after brand name
modes.description: 'is' or 'are' directly follows a capitalized brand name as the subject of a sentence.
modes.example: TIVICAY<< is>> available in two dosage forms: • T

modes.label: Modifier before a product term
modes.description: A word such as 'low', 'reduced' or 'co' sits before a noun like carbohydrate, alcohol or administered.
modes.example: INVEGA SUSTENNA is<< co>>administered with risperidone

card.writes: It seems to push toward descriptive continuations and away from the word 'product' in its various forms.
card.plain: It lights up on the 'is' or 'are' right after a brand drug name that opens a sentence.
